text: Paytm debited Rs 799 twice on 30 September 2026. I raised a complaint with Paytm on 2 October 2026. They replied on 15 October 2026 but I am not satisfied with the reply.
note: Expected dates hand-computed from RB-IOS 2026 (30-day wait, 90-day window from the later of wait end and last reply).
